guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 本課以原水特性、瓶杯試驗、混凝與絮體成長為主線，從原水變化與處理目的、瓶杯試驗比較設計、活性成分與投加質量、儲液與計量泵換算進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
guides.conceptEn: This course develops raw-water characteristics, jar tests, coagulation and floc growth through ten connected units, beginning with source variability and treatment goals, jar-test comparison design, active ingredient and dosing mass, solution and metering-pump conversion. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

evidence: 在離線工作台先選取「原水變化與處理目的」的觀測點。比對累積流量計與流量比例混合樣本。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「瓶杯試驗比較設計」的觀測點。所有杯使用相同攪拌、沉降時間並同時量 pH。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「活性成分與投加質量」的觀測點。以藥液消耗稱重與處理水量交叉核對。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「儲液與計量泵換算」的觀測點。核對供應商分析證明與實測密度、泵標定。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「快混分散與局部剪切」的觀測點。校正軸功率、黏度與有效槽容，觀察局部絮體破碎。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「膠凝碰撞與停留」的觀測點。觀察絮體尺寸、沉降性與攪拌功率。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「輸送破碎與復原」的觀測點。所有杯使用相同攪拌、沉降時間並同時量 pH。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「澄清負荷與沉降」的觀測點。將流量、池面積與沉降柱結果一起比較。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「後續過濾連結」的觀測點。逐池量流量與水頭損失，檢查分配不均。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
在離線工作台先選取「殘餘物與驗證報告」的觀測點。畫出所有邊界流股，分列不確定度及庫存變化。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
evidenceEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for source variability and treatment goals. Compare the totalizing flowmeter with a flow-proportional composite sample. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for jar-test comparison design. Use matching mixing/settling times across jars and measure pH. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for active ingredient and dosing mass. Cross-check weighed reagent consumption against treated flow. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for solution and metering-pump conversion. Check certificate of analysis, measured density and pump calibration. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for rapid dispersion and local shear. Check shaft power, viscosity and effective volume and observe local floc breakage. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for flocculation collisions and residence. Observe floc size, settleability and mixing power. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for transfer breakup and recovery. Use matching mixing/settling times across jars and measure pH. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for clarifier loading and settling. Compare flow and plan area with settling-column observations. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for link to downstream filtration. Measure each filter flow/head loss and check maldistribution. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

In the offline workbench, select the observation point for residuals and verification report. Draw every boundary stream and separate uncertainty from inventory change. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
pitfalls: 只依原水濁度線性決定藥量。診斷與介入：先回查濃度基準與流量加權採樣，再重算負荷。
同時改藥劑、pH 與時間而宣稱單因素效果。診斷與介入：重做同批原水平行試驗，分開藥量、剪切與時間的影響。
把標示溶液重量當活性成分重量。診斷與介入：核對活性成分、流量和投加量換算，避免把示例作為推薦設定。
換了濃度卻沿用原體積設定。診斷與介入：重新確認濃度標示、密度與計量泵實測出量。
以平均功率足夠就忽略藥點混合死角。診斷與介入：查實際傳入水中功率、黏度與死角，觀察絮體而非只看電表。
只延長時間而忽略後段剪切破碎。診斷與介入：同時比較絮體破碎、沉降和殘濁，離線修正混合分段。
瓶杯試驗很好便忽略實廠輸送剪切。診斷與介入：重做同批原水平行試驗，分開藥量、剪切與時間的影響。
只追求化學去除而忽略池體短流。診斷與介入：比較分池流量及沉降測試，先評估配流是否失衡。
只以澄清池出水最低濁度判定整廠最優。診斷與介入：扣掉停用面積重算濾速，核對各池流量與水質。
忽略污泥增加與處置需求。診斷與介入：補列回流、庫存與採樣不確定度，保留無法解釋的差額。
pitfallsEn: Dose is determined only by a linear turbidity relationship. Diagnostic response: First check the concentration basis and flow-weighted sampling, then recalculate loading.
Reagent, pH and time are changed together but interpreted as one-factor effects. Diagnostic response: Repeat parallel tests on one water batch, separating dose, shear and time effects.
Solution mass is mistaken for active-ingredient mass. Diagnostic response: Check active strength, flow and dosing conversion; do not use the example as a recommended setting.
A changed solution strength retains the old volumetric setting. Diagnostic response: Reconfirm concentration labeling, density and measured pump delivery.
Adequate mean power hides dead zones near injection. Diagnostic response: Check power delivered to water, viscosity and dead zones, observing flocs rather than electricity alone.
Longer time is assumed beneficial despite downstream breakup. Diagnostic response: Compare breakup, settling and residual turbidity while revising mixing stages offline.
Good jar results lead to ignoring full-scale transfer shear. Diagnostic response: Repeat parallel tests on one water batch, separating dose, shear and time effects.
Chemical removal is optimized while hydraulic bypass is ignored. Diagnostic response: Compare cell flows and settling tests, first checking distribution imbalance.
Lowest clarifier turbidity alone is used to identify the plant optimum. Diagnostic response: Recalculate using online area and check cell flows/quality.
Additional sludge and residual management are omitted. Diagnostic response: Add recycle, inventory and sampling uncertainty, retaining unexplained differences.

history.title: 飲用水混凝膠凝
history.text: 本課以公開技術手冊建立方法背景；來源出版年代不代表此程序首次發明的年代。舊版文件僅提供原理與歷史脈絡，現場工作仍須確認當地現行規定與設備文件。
history.textEn: Public technical manuals establish the methodological background; publication dates do not identify the invention date. Older documents provide principles and historical context, while real work still requires current local requirements and equipment documentation.

courses.connection: 本課以原水特性、瓶杯試驗、混凝與絮體成長為主線，從原水變化與處理目的、瓶杯試驗比較設計、活性成分與投加質量、儲液與計量泵換算進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
courses.connectionEn: This course develops raw-water characteristics, jar tests, coagulation and floc growth through ten connected units, beginning with source variability and treatment goals, jar-test comparison design, active ingredient and dosing mass, solution and metering-pump conversion. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.
